title: Hollywood Principle Drop New Single Titled "Maxine"
htmlContent:
Hollywood Principle has recently released its latest single, "Maxine," and it's already making waves in the music industry. Known for their unique blend of electronic, pop, and hip hop, the San Diego-based trio has once again delivered a dynamic and powerful track that will capture listeners' attention.

"Maxine," tells a compelling story of lost love and the desire to reconnect with a former flame. The track features an upbeat pop sound, with hints of R&B and hip-hop that add a modern and sexy edge to the music. The lyrics are relatable and emotionally charged, touching on themes that many listeners will find familiar.

Hollywood Principle has been making music since 2013, and they've steadily built a loyal fan base over the years. Their music has been featured in popular games like "Rocket League," introducing their music to a broader audience. With "Maxine," the trio shows they're still at the top of their game and poised to take the music world by storm.
